# About Me

::: {.bio}
I am a biostatistician working on data-driven decision making for public health impact. My research develops statistical methods to address problems in environmental health, electronic health records, and disease surveillance by bringing together **causal inference, spatiotemporal statistics, and informative missingness.**

I am a postdoctoral researcher at Emory University, working with [Howard Chang](https://sph.emory.edu/profile/faculty/howard-chang) and [Razieh Nabi](https://raziehnabi.com/), and a member of the [SPENSER lab](https://www.spenser-lab.org/). I received my PhD in Biostatistics from Emory in 2025, advised by [Lance Waller](https://sph.emory.edu/profile/faculty/lance-waller).
:::
